page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.26xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core count and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.g6.26xlarge offers significant resource density for enterprise-scale workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This configuration is suitable for multi-threaded applications, large-scale web serving, enterprise application hosting, and moderate database workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
